title: Department Rule on the Relief Lookback Period for Late Report Penalty Relief
content:
**1. Counting.** For penalty relief on the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, other late report penalties are counted over the relief lookback. The relief lookback is counted in whole months back from the day of the request, by the entry dates of the penalties.

**2. Where it starts.** Where the relief lookback starts follows the account's standing, read from the account's status and its late payment interest entries:

| Account standing | Relief lookback |
|---|---|
| Delinquent status | The whole liability since registration: one month more than the whole months of liability |
| Active status, with no late payment interest entry booked within the payment record months of 12, and an earlier late payment interest entry on the account | Back only to its most recent late payment interest entry: one month more than the whole months since that entry's date |
| Active status, never charged late payment interest | The whole liability since registration: one month more than the whole months of liability |
| Any other account | The class's penalty abatement lookback quarters, 8 in every class, counted as three months each: 24 months |

**3. Windows.** The 12-month test is counted in whole months back from the day of the request, by the entry dates of the interest entries. Whole months of liability run from the registration date on the account to the day of the request.

## Hypothetical accounts, request on 15 August 2026

- **Delinquent, registered 50 whole months before.** Relief lookback: 51 months.
- **Active; latest late payment interest entry on 3 December 2024, none within 12 months.** Whole months since that entry: 20; relief lookback: 21 months.
- **Active; never charged late payment interest; 40 whole months since registration.** Relief lookback: 41 months.
- **Active; a late payment interest entry booked 7 months before the request.** Relief lookback: 24 months.
- **Inactive.** Relief lookback: 24 months.
